title: Six-class metered rho v13: self-itemized step price, doubling escapes and a 2^16-node report partition

claims.statement: Conditional analytic full-production secp256k1 ECDLP claim: the specified six-class (negation and GLV) parallel rho walk with doubling escapes, a global work meter and a 2^16-node report partition recovers a uniform challenge logarithm with probability at least 0.40 within 2^(12703/100) classical target-operation equivalents at protected C=1000. Let r be the secp256k1 group order, N=(r-1)/6 classes, R=2^20 twisted table entries, DP spacing 2^69, 2^20 workers, 2^16 storage nodes with 2^43-record caps, 192-byte records. S_ops=ceil(sqrt(2*N'*ln(1/0.58))) with N'=N*R/(R-1) is the hard phase-1 arrival counter (2^126.76932). The ordinary step is priced 1.11 units: one reference batched affine addition (C=1000, 6M=1074 instructions, not charged twice) plus a 21-row itemised control ceiling of 110 instructions. Doubling is priced 2.35 (7M+6A+3M inversion share+200 with M<=200 limb-counted). Phase 1 is 2^126.91988, hard extras below 2^89.01, expected doubling surcharge 2^107.30, raw ledger 2^126.91988, and the 27/25 reserve gives 2^127.03092. Success is eta_model=0.420 minus a Markov early-halt below 0.00003 and listed probability debits, hence at least 0.40. H1 (all-arrival collision statistic), the six-class twist uniformity clause, the truncated canonical-index rule with its metered exact fallback, and the instruction ceilings are disclosed heuristics supported at toy scale only; this is not an unconditional theorem and no production execution is claimed.
